posts.author: ATT_Turan
posts.body:
That's the wrong place to put all of those commands.
That's saying your boulder is going to sit in one place and when the player touches it (Trigger: Player Touch) it will set a switch and set its location and move back and forth and turn a switch off (except the switch will never turn off unless the player walks into it again).
It also doesn't appear to do what you said you want - you said you want it to go down and teleport back to the beginning (loop), but that move route is moving down and moving back up.
The movement commands should go in the Autonomous Movement section and the event commands are whatever you want to happen to the player when the boulder hits them.
The script call at the bottom is to teleport it back to its starting location - I Googled "rpg maker vx ace script call transfer" and got this syntax:
Code:
$game_map.events[4].moveto(11, 6)
The 4 is the event ID of the boulder, and the 11, 6 are the X, Y map coordinates for it to go to.
